atoms.text: Mimi only has the smallest ocean left to explore. Will you help her search the Arctic Ocean?

instruction.text: Can you point out the Arctic Ocean to Mimi on the map?

hint.text: The Arctic Ocean is even colder than the Southern Ocean.

atoms.a: “Do you think I can search for treasure underwater here?”
atoms.sound: ssml:<voice voiceLang='en' voice='f10'>Do you think I can search for treasure underwater here?</voice>

instruction.text: Mimi wants to know how the Arctic Ocean is different from the Indian Ocean. Drag the images to the correct group.

hint.text: Many colourful sea animals and plants can’t survive the cold of the Arctic and can only be found in warmer waters.

instruction.text: Mimi spots a wild animal on some ice. Find the polar bear in this image to tell her a fun fact.

feedback.end: Polar bears can be found here in the Arctic but not in Antarctica.

instruction.text: Can you remember where the Arctic Ocean is on the map? Drag the label to the correct place on the image.

hint.text: The Arctic Ocean is on the opposite side of the world to Antarctica.
